🌿 Branching model: release-branches
   Long-lived branches : stable, maint/X.Y
   Work branches       : feat/, fix/, docs/, ... from 'stable', pull requests into 'stable'; fixes of a release in acceptance or maintenance from 'maint/X.Y', pull requests into it
   Release candidate   : cut 'maint/X.Y' from 'stable' after the version bump; vX.Y.Z-rc.N tagged on 'maint/X.Y'; fixes go into 'maint/X.Y' and forward into 'stable' by pull request
   Release gate (user) : the user runs the promote workflow for the accepted candidate; it tags that commit vX.Y.Z and releases it
   Hotfix              : fix/<slug> from 'maint/X.Y', pull request into it, patch bump, candidate, promote, then forward into 'stable' by pull request
   ℹ️ devops.integration_branch is not used by 'release-branches'
